# License note for multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills (written by the kit)

The upstream repository (https://github.com/multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills, commit
2c606141936f1eeef17fa3043a72095b4765b9c2) has no LICENSE file. Its license is stated in two places:

- `README.md`, section "License": `MIT`
- `skills/karpathy-guidelines/SKILL.md`, frontmatter: `license: MIT`

No copyright line is given. The kit copies `skills/karpathy-guidelines/SKILL.md` unchanged under
the MIT License below and attributes it to the contributors of that repository. This decision
was approved by the reviewer on 2026-11-06 (docs/v2/07_SOURCES_EVALUATION.md §8, Q2).
